title: Applicability to Specific Districts
previewText: In C3A Districts, the bulk regulations of this Chapter shall not apply. In lieu thereof, the bulk regulations for R3A Districts in Article II, Chapter 3 (Residential Bulk Regulations in Residence Districts), shall apply.
